title: Contents
slide_intent: Orient a reader to the organizing idea and the page sequence so they can choose where to look next.
strategic_value: Halfkey can introduce its countable-dot convention at the point of navigation. Counting dots already helps the reader locate the current page.
demonstration: The left column states the brand premise and explains the value of a full, spent or empty position. Two columns on the right group the numbered contents. A row of 20 dots highlights position two in blue.
practical_value: An editor can use a topic group to find a page and use the highlighted dot to locate that page within the book.

content_islands.name: Running header
content_islands.spec: Place the book identifiers at upper left and Contents with page 02 at upper right.

content_islands.name: Brand premise
content_islands.spec: Set the one-line brand idea as a large multiline statement in the left column. Place the short explanation of the allowance dots below it.

content_islands.name: Contents index
content_islands.spec: Stack Foundations above Signature in the middle column and Product above Market at right. Pair every title with its page number and separate adjacent entries with thin rules.

content_islands.name: Page indicator
content_islands.spec: Place the one-dot-per-page caption and row of twenty dots along the lower left. Use blue for the second dot.
